provenance_note: Selected factual fields from locally retained historical receipts. Original artifact SHA-256 identities are preserved. This is not a fresh hardware run or an independent signature.
limitations: One short recorded civilian OOK signal, not a live RF input or broad protocol validation.
Byte savings compare spectral packet formats, not raw CU8 file size. The raw file is 131072 bytes.
Packet byte statistics use 2049 frames touching valid input. The additional 952 zero-padding frames are excluded from the headline savings.
Relative L2 is measured against the fixed-point adapter reference and excludes its own conversion error.
No CPU speed, workload, power or live-throughput claim is made.
Hardware evidence records an earlier session. It does not describe the board image currently active.
Raw RF samples and returned waveform/packet captures are intentionally excluded from this publication.
